intro: Luxus makes hosting feel effortless. A sanded tempered glass top and manual butterfly extension open at one end, adding room with steady legroom and a calm modern presence. Always.

features.title: Butterfly extension that welcomes more
features.text: A manual butterfly mechanism opens seamlessly at one end, giving you extra setting space the moment guests arrive, without heavy lifting or rearranging the entire room layout.

features.title: Glass that keeps its elegant finish
features.text: The 10 mm sanded tempered glass top with a high scratch-resistant marble finish resists everyday scuffs, so your table stays gracefully composed through constant use.

features.title: Leg space planned for comfort
features.text: Designed for six every day and eight when extended, the leg geometry preserves knee room, bags, and foot space, so seating more people does not mean sacrificing ease.

features.title: Powder-coated metal that feels solid
features.text: A powder-coated metal understructure steadies the glass top, giving you a table that feels composed under heavy platters and confident when families gather around.

features.title: Clean silhouette that calms the room
features.text: A contemporary profile with a distinctive tabletop edge makes the setting feel styled yet unshowy, turning busy meals into organized, visually calm moments together.

features.title: Knockdown convenience for real moves
features.text: Delivered in two packets and designed knockdown, it passes easily through doors and lifts, then assembles strong so new homes and new layouts stay stress-free.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
